$comment: Routes from https://primefold.ai/sitemap.xml (fetched 2026-10-13) and src/App.jsx. Section lists per template mirror design-repo/templates/templates.json; section contracts live in design-repo/sections/ and cite specs/*.md and CLONE_SPEC.md.

meta.title: Primefold (primefold.ai) — information architecture
meta.status: complete-pending-review — all 13 templates mapped to section contracts from design-repo/ and every section implemented in the clone (product pages built in design-repo 0.3.0; legal, blog-post and case-study bodies decomposed in 0.2.0); production approval is a human sign-off

categories.SHELL: Site chrome on every route: navigation and footer.
categories.PROOF: Social proof and trust: logos, testimonials, outcomes, security.
categories.CONVERSION: Call-to-action blocks driving to Book a call.
categories.CONTENT: Page body content: article, prose, cards, forms and other page-specific blocks.

shell.navbar.description: Fixed top navigation: logo, Products/Resources/Company dropdowns, Plans and Security links, Sign in + Book a call pill buttons; switches from transparent to a blurred white bar after ~100px scroll; hamburger menu below 1200px.

hero.home-carousel.description: Full-viewport 3-slide autoplay carousel (Platform / Experience Intelligence / Real Estate Intelligence) with 6s progress tabs, staggered text entrance and 0.6x scroll parallax.

proof.logo-ticker.description: Infinite horizontal customer-logo marquee at 50px/s with staggered logo fade-in.

features.how-it-works.description: 'How a question becomes a next move' title stack plus the dark A1 Loop product demo: a 9-state animated loop (ask, read sources, understand, answer, act, trace).

features.intelligence-cards.description: 'One engine' row of three intelligence product cards (XI live, RI beta, next planned) that widen on hover on desktop and become sticky stacked cards on tablet/phone.

proof.testimonials.description: Full-width dark testimonial carousel: large quote, person name/role, client logo, arrow + dot controls, 0.5s slide.

features.solutions-carousel.description: 'Built for every team' horizontally scrolling team/use-case image cards with scroll-linked sideways drift and Explore arrow buttons.

proof.trust.description: Trust block: list of security/compliance points with a 10s teal progress line next to an animated Lottie panel (hosting, GDPR, source tracing).

proof.outcomes.description: 'Real impact. Real outcomes.' dark customer outcome cards with rolling 80px numbers, outcome headline, person and client logo.

conversion.cta-band.description: Dark rounded CTA card 'Ask your data. Get the answer.' with animated wave background and a white Book a call pill.

shell.footer.description: Footer card: brand blurb + newsletter form, four link columns (Products, Explore, Resources, Company), legal/social row, hosted-in-Germany row, and the sticky ghost 'Primefold' wordmark revealed beneath it.

hero.product-live-chat.description: Dark product hero: eyebrow badge, h1, lead, two CTAs and a typing 'Live Conversation' chat demo over a WebGL rays background; one hero template serves both intelligences via the product enum.

features.step-cards.description: 'Ask. Understand. Act.' three illustrated step cards; XI uses light animated illustrations, RI uses dark A1-style demo panels.

features.use-cases.description: Sticky 'Used by' label beside a scroll-highlighted list of use cases (only one item at opacity 1 at a time).

features.sources.description: 'Sources' block: left list of three trust points (connects in minutes, traceable, hosted in Germany) beside a Lottie (XI) or dark 'A3 Sources' loop (RI).

features.solutions-tabs.description: 'Built for every team' tabbed panel (persona tabs) with an image card and a dark card showing marquee quote pills plus 'What you get'. Not the home carousel.

features.loop-cards.description: 'The loop' four small cards explaining how the product learns a customer's vocabulary, definitions, judgment and workspace.

hero.pricing.description: Plans hero: eyebrow, h1, lead, two CTAs, product and billing toggles and the three pricing cards (XI state) or one 'Explore Primefold RI' card (RI state).

features.comparison-table.description: Plan comparison table with sticky plan header and sticky category rows; shown only in the XI state of /plans.

features.info-card-grid.description: Section title row (eyebrow, H2, optional lead) over a grid of small icon+title+description info cards; used for plan trust ('In every plan'), security facts and company commitments. Variant selects the column count.
features.info-card-grid.implementedBy: src/pages/shared-info/InfoCard.jsx + src/pages/shared-info/SectionTitle.jsx + src/pages/shared-info/MaskIcon.jsx + src/pages/plans/PlansTrust.jsx + src/pages/security/FourFacts.jsx + src/pages/company/Commitments.jsx

features.faq-accordion.description: FAQ accordion: independent expandable cards (first open by default) under a title row with a lead.

hero.security-comet.description: Dark security hero with warm glow, eyebrow, h1, lead, Book a call and an animated three-ring comet graphic around a GDPR/fingerprint pill.

proof.trust-image-cards.description: Two shader-backed image cards with a dark bottom overlay and white headline + body (security trust statements).

conversion.contact-form.description: Two-column contact section: intro with three link cards (email, booking, LinkedIn) and a 'Send us a message' form card (name, work mail, company, optional phone with country picker, message, consent, submit).

hero.company-stats.description: Company hero over a full-bleed photo: eyebrow, h1, lead with a bold clause, two CTAs and four glass stat cards.

features.team-ticker.description: Team section: title row over an edge-to-edge auto-scrolling ticker of team cards (square photo, name, role).

hero.careers.description: Light careers hero: eyebrow, h1, lead, black 'See open roles' anchor button, and two shader-backed cards ('How you work', 'How we hire').

content.open-roles.description: Open roles list (#roles): title block and static job rows with meta line, h5, description and a black Apply button.

content.legal-header.description: Legal document opening: h1 title plus any preamble blocks before the first heading-bounded part (the whole imprint, which has no headings; the version line of data privacy).

content.legal-part.description: One heading-bounded part of a legal document: a heading of the document's dominant level (h2 in terms of service, h4 in data privacy) and the blocks until the next heading of that level. Repeatable; imprint has none.

hero.index-intro.description: Index-page hero for the CMS lists: eyebrow, h1, lead and either a newsletter form (blog) or a black Book a call button (case studies).

content.card-grid.description: Responsive grid of linked cards (16:9 image, then title and meta); blog variant shows date + author, case-study variant shows a 'Read story' row.

content.article-header.description: Blog post opening: h1, divider, author + 'Last updated' meta row, 16:9 banner, and any intro blocks before the first chapter heading.

content.article-body.description: One chapter of a blog post body: a chapter heading (h2, or h3 where a post has no h2) and the rich-text blocks until the next chapter heading (paragraphs, lists, quote, images, video facade, in-body buttons). Repeatable.

content.case-study-header.description: Case-study opening: breadcrumb, h1, subtitle, divider, product/industry pills and the full-width banner.

proof.case-study-stats.description: Three outcome stat cards (value + label) directly under the case-study banner. Values are customer-attributed claims.

content.case-study-body.description: One chapter of a case-study story: an h6 eyebrow / h3 heading and the blocks until the next one (paragraphs, quote cards, numbered cards, video). Repeatable.

content.case-study-about.description: About-the-client block closing a case study: heading, image card (client imagery, client logo, description, website button) and an information card (employees / clients / industry / products in use).

content.not-found.description: 404 block: eyebrow, 404 h1, 'Nothing to see here.' h2, one line of copy and a black Back to homepage button.
